script.cover_1: Camera on for every single call? Your manager insists.
script.payoff: Some teams treat it as a norm, and asking which calls need it is fair.
script.caption: Camera rules are rarely written and often assumed. Send this to the friend who dresses only from the waist up.
script.situation: Can your manager ask for your camera on in every call?
script.answer: Some teams do it to feel connected, so it may be a norm. Asking which calls need it is fair.
script.reply_me: Is the camera needed on every call, or only for client calls? I will plan my setup around it.
